statements.status_notes: RUSTSEC-2024-0436 reports that paste is unmaintained with no active development or security fixes. The qdrant binary uses paste as a procedural macro for code generation at compile time. While no specific vulnerability is identified and the macro only affects build-time code generation (not runtime behavior), the lack of maintenance poses a long-term risk. Investigation is ongoing to assess whether upstream qdrant can migrate to maintained alternatives or inline the macro functionality.
